rationale: Mixed signals. Positives: #1 global box office (Superman, Weapons, One Battle After Another), 30M streaming net adds in 3 yrs, Q3 streaming EBITDA $1.3B (vs $-2.5B three years ago), net leverage down to 3.3x, $1B bridge-loan paydown, strong HBO slate (It: Welcome to Derry third-most-watched series premiere). Negatives: EPS beat was razor-thin ($-0.06 vs $-0.068), explicit ARPU pressure acknowledged for 'next 3 quarters' in U.S. (affiliate reset + ad-tier dilution), linear affiliate increases at only 2% (below peers) with higher subscriber declines, no hard forward financial guidance given ($3B studio EBITDA is an 'ambition', not guidance), management explicitly refuses to take questions on strategic alternatives (which is the primary stock catalyst). Opening remarks heavily retrospective/celebratory rather than forward-looking. CNN/TNT Sports standalone apps add operational complexity at a time of separation. The stock's momentum appears driven by M&A speculation that management won't discuss on the call. Operating fundamentals are solid but not a clean beat-and-raise; ARPU drag is an explicit near-term headwind.

Textbook beat-and-raise with multiple specific forward catalysts. EPS $1.78 vs $1.72 expected, revenue $4.1B +9% seq / +49% YoY. Gross margin 38.5% at high end of guide, up 220bps seq; operating margin 21.6% highest in 5 yrs. Explicit mix guidance RAISED: enterprise SSD from ~10% to 15-20% of bits (already exceeded 15% in Q1), qualifications doubled since Q4. Specific high-credibility catalysts: NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 reference-architecture qualification, third hyperscaler qualified UltraSMR (ramp imminent), 32TB UltraSMR and 26TB CMR (industry-first 11-disk) drives just launched, 30/60TB high-capacity SSDs in qualification. HDD nearline bit shipments record 141EB (+157% YoY), avg price/unit up 46% to $164. Management explicitly says 'demand exceeds supply' in HDD, moving customers to 2-6 quarter agreement cycles — structural visibility improvement. Spin-off of Flash/HDD tracking to complete by end of December quarter — concrete near-term catalyst with financing activities starting imminently. Q&A is direct, specific, confident, with CEO giving granular roadmap detail (11-platter, HAMR bridge, BiCS8 2Tb die). Minor/well-explained near-term: Q2 GM guide midpoint 38% (flat HDD, slight Flash cost headwind), consumer/client softness but offset by eSSD ramp and seasonal strength. AI Data Cycle tailwind repeatedly substantiated with customer data points.
